question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is honored as illumination and total power?
premises: The Eye is described as illumination-natured
The Eye belongs to the two Śivas and is supreme
inference: The supreme Eye of the two Śivas, luminous and all-powerful, is bowed to
uncertainties: The dual śivayoḥ may refer to Śiva and Śivā or another paired conception
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all powers.
